learning: Every earlier normal row, five complete streaming partial_fit passes. Separate cold five and warm eight dimensions. Gaussian ranks fitted only to past normals, one-hot time/channel plus unknown indicator, fixed approximate RBF map, SGDOneClassSVM average=True/optimal rate/shuffle=True/random_state=42. Empirical decision-tail references and context/global shrinkage500. No sampled-away normal rows, no labeled anomaly in normal fit. Save numeric weights/offset/maps; verify decisions equal sklearn and complete row updates.
limits: Approximate RBF normal boundary with five SGD passes and 256 random features is an experimental candidate, not evidence of optimum or convergence. Nu is a training parameter, not measured false-positive rate. In-sample tail references are not held-out calibration; unknown category embeddings were not observed in normal fit. Coarse bucket/low-amount/synthetic-label restrictions retained. Score is not fraud probability/p-value.
mean_control: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of the two verified supervised scores, float64. An ensemble ranking score, not a calibrated fraud probability. Added before any copula fit after observing different performance directions in the first two deep folds; not an original-study preregistration.
selection: supervised>=a OR(novelty>=b AND supervised>=c); fixed b/c grid, all distinct a with ties, disabled heads preserved. Same full development population, four targets unchanged. Report threshold combinations, not unique alert sets.
evaluation_limit: New nonlinear design responds to observed copula development failure; all policy selection uses the same past development labels. Not independent validation; no 2024 selection or deployment claim.
